evaluation.bracket_convention: [X,Y]_gb = [X,Y]_0 (structure_ref) + κ Σ_Z gamma_evaluated[X,Y,Z] Z;  Z = 'K' is the central part

profiles.name: row_split
profiles.description: gb = +1 on row a_1_p, -1 on row a_1_m (sign of σ)

profiles.name: column_split
profiles.description: gb = +1 on columns b_j_p, -1 on columns b_j_m (sign of s)

profiles.name: alternating_j
profiles.description: gb = (-1)^(j+1) (sign alternates with boson index j)
